## Description

Constructs directed information flow graphs using Transfer Entropy between asset returns, passing adjacency matrices through Graph Neural Networks to forecast cross-sectional lead-lag alpha returns.

## Where it may fit

Cross-sectional stock forecasting, index constituent lead-lag propagation, multi-asset alpha generation.

## Vehicles

Quantitative Equity Funds, Statistical Arbitrage Desks.

## Required data

High-frequency and daily return series across broad equity universes, Transfer Entropy matrices.

## Caveats

Transfer entropy estimation is computationally intensive and sensitive to sliding window length selection.
